proposal.summary: Controller 6000 firmware exposes a buffer overflow vulnerability via the diagnostic web interface upload feature, affecting multiple prior vCR8.x versions.
proposal.affected_product: Controller 6000 (firmware versions prior to vCR8.80.230201a, vCR8.70.230201a, vCR8.60.230201b, vCR8.50.230201a, and all versions of vCR8.40 and prior)

C.quote: "buffer overflow via the Controller diagnostic web interface upload feature"

evidence_quotes.claim: The Buffer overflow via the Controller diagnostic web interface upload feature
evidence_quotes.quote: Controller 6000 is vulnerable to a buffer overflow via the Controller diagnostic web interface upload feature.
This issue affects Controller 6000: before vCR8.80.230201a, before vCR8.70.230201a, before vCR8.60.230201b, before vCR8.50.230201a, all versions of vCR8.40 and prior.
